key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 16：非齐次 Schrödinger 方程解算子的逆向刻画
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 16: converse characterization of the inhomogeneous Schrödinger solution operator
key_objects.description: Assume u is L2-valued and continuous in time, u(0)=0, and (1/i)∂_t u-Δu=F distributionally with F∈L2. Prove u=S(F), using the interaction-picture quantity e^{-itΔ}(u-S(F)).

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 17：临界非线性 Schrödinger 方程的唯一性与对初值连续依赖
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 17: uniqueness and continuous dependence for the critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation
key_objects.description: For λ=(d+4)/d and q=(2d+4)/d, prove uniqueness of strong solutions with the same initial data and local Lipschitz dependence on nearby L2 initial data by subdividing time and reusing the contraction estimate from Theorem 6.9.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 18：奇维双线性 Radon 变换的 L2 恒等式与反演公式
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 18: L2 identity and inversion formula for the bilinear Radon transform in odd dimension
key_objects.description: For nondegenerate bilinear B in odd dimension, establish the fractional x_d-derivative L2 identity, identify the formal adjoint, and deduce the inversion formula for R_B.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 18 的 Radon 反演公式
key_objects.name_en: Radon inversion formula in Exercise 18

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 19：局部 Radon 变换的 Sobolev 平滑
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 19: Sobolev smoothing for a localized Radon transform
key_objects.description: For R_B' = η'R_B(ηf), prove L2 boundedness, commute general derivatives into x_d-derivatives plus cutoff terms, and deduce boundedness L2→L2_{(d-1)/2}.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 20：平均算子的解析插值 Lp→Lq 估计
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 20: analytic interpolation proof of Lp-to-Lq bounds for the averaging operator
key_objects.description: Define T_s=(1-2^{1-s})e^{s^2}Σ_{k=0}^r2^{-ks}A_k. Prove the L2 bound on Re(s)=-(d-1)/2 and L1→L∞ bound on Re(s)=1, then interpolate at s=0 to obtain p=(d+1)/d and q=d+1 uniformly in r.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 21：凸域膨胀对小平移的吸收
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 21: absorption of small translations by a dilation of a convex domain
key_objects.description: If Ω is bounded, convex, C2, and contains 0, show x∈RΩ and |y|≤δ imply x+y∈(R+cδ)Ω. The hint reduces to R=1 and uses a local graph plus convexity.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 22：加权除数函数和的上下尾估计
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 22: upper and tail estimates for weighted divisor sums
key_objects.description: Prove Σ_{k≤r}d(k)k^α=O(r^{α+1}log r) for α>-1 and Σ_{k>r}d(k)k^α=O(r^{α+1}log r) for α<-1 by writing d(k) as a divisor convolution.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 23：Bessel 函数递推导出 rJ1(r) 积分恒等式
key_objects.name_en: Exercise 23: deriving the integral identity for rJ1(r) from Bessel recurrences
key_objects.description: Verify J1'(r)=1/2(J0-J2) and J1(r)=r/2(J0+J2), hence d(rJ1)/dr=rJ0 and rJ1(r)=∫_0^r σJ0(σ)dσ.

key_objects.name_zh: Exercise 23 的 Bessel 积分恒等式
key_objects.name_en: Bessel integral identity in Exercise 23

key_objects.name_zh: 第 10 节：Problems
key_objects.name_en: Section 10: Problems
key_objects.description: The chapter problems are guides to further results rather than routine exercises; literature sources are given in Notes and References.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 1*：Gauss 映射与 Gauss 曲率
key_objects.name_en: Problem 1*: Gauss map and Gauss curvature
key_objects.description: For a local hypersurface M, relate nonvanishing Gauss curvature to local diffeomorphism of the Gauss map and identify the pullback measure by K dσ_M=(dσ_{S^{d-1}})^*.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 2*：球面极大函数
key_objects.name_en: Problem 2*: the spherical maximal function
key_objects.description: For spherical averages A_t, state and motivate the maximal estimate ||A* f||_p≤c_p||f||_p when p>d/(d-1), including the local p=2 argument in d≥3 using a t-derivative estimate.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 3*：波动方程的逐点初值恢复
key_objects.name_en: Problem 3*: pointwise recovery of initial velocity for the wave equation
key_objects.description: For the wave equation with u(x,0)=0 and ∂_t u(x,0)=f, the problem states almost-everywhere convergence u(x,t)/t→f(x) for f∈Lp with p>2d/(d+1).

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 4*：二维 restriction 定理的完整范围
key_objects.name_en: Problem 4*: the full restriction range in dimension two
key_objects.description: Show the restriction phenomenon in R2 for 1≤p<4/3 by duality and the absolute continuity/Lr estimate for ν*ν, followed by Hausdorff-Young.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 5*：波动方程的 Strichartz 型估计
key_objects.name_en: Problem 5*: a Strichartz-type estimate for the wave equation
key_objects.description: For wave evolution with zero displacement and initial velocity f, establish the spacetime estimate with q=(2d+2)/(d-2), d≥3.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 6*：Gauss 圆问题误差项 E(R) 的进一步结果
key_objects.name_en: Problem 6*: further results on the Gauss-circle error E(R)
key_objects.description: Collect the Hardy series representation, mean-square asymptotic, unbounded normalized limsup, and improved exponent results for E(R)=N(R)-πR^2, including α=131/208.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 7*：J(λ) 与第二、第三类 Bessel 函数
key_objects.name_en: Problem 7*: identification of J(λ) with Bessel functions of the second and third kinds
key_objects.description: Identify J(λ)=4K0(2λ)-2πY0(2λ), with Y_m the Neumann and K_m the Macdonald functions.

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 7* 的 J(λ) Bessel 表示
key_objects.name_en: Bessel representation of J(λ) in Problem 7*

key_objects.name_zh: Problem 8*：除数问题误差 Δ(μ) 的 Voronoi 型级数
key_objects.name_en: Problem 8*: Voronoi-type series for the divisor-problem error Δ(μ)
key_objects.description: For noninteger μ, express Δ(μ) by a convergent series involving K1 and Y1 and note analogous estimates Δ(μ)=O(μ^{β+ε}) with β=α/2.
